source.diagram: Na2O-SiO2 phase diagram according to Kracek [1-3] (from 50 to 100 mass % SiO2) and Willgallis [4], with the additional compound 3Na2O·8SiO2
source.caption: Atlas text (printed p. 94): 'Fig. 3.137. Na2O-SiO2 phase diagram according to Kracek [1-3] (from 50 to 100 mass % SiO2) and Willgallis [4], with the additional compound 3Na2O·8SiO2 found by Williamson, Glasser [5] and confirmed by Mogensen, Christensen [6]. The phase equilibria involving 3Na2O·8SiO2 have been drawn after Glasser, Marr [7] and Lee et al. [8]. The phase relations in the Na2O-rich region of the system after D'Ans, Löffler [9] and Löffler [10]. For the SiO2-rich part of the system with tridymite stable only as a binary solution phase, see Holmquist [11]. For thermodynamic assessment of the system and calculated phase diagram, see Wu et al. [12].' References: [1] Kracek, F. C.: J. Am. Chem. Soc. 52 (1930), p. 1436/42; [2] Kracek, F. C.: J. Phys. Chem. 34 (1930), p. 1583/98; [3] Kracek, F. C.: J. Am. Chem. Soc. 61 (1939) No. 10, p. 2863/77; [4] Willgallis, A.: Glastech. Ber. 42 (1969) No. 12, p. 506/9; [5] Williamson, J., F. P. Glasser: Science 148 (1965) No. 6, p. 1589/91; [6] Mogensen, G., N. H. Christensen: Phys. Chem. Glasses 22 (1981) No. 1, p. 17/22; [7] Glasser, F. P., J. Marr: J. Am. Ceram. Soc. 62 (1979) No. 1-2, p. 42/7; [8] Lee, F. C., J. Marr, R. P. Gunawardane, F. P., Glasser: Br. Ceram. Trans. J. 90 (1991) No. 1, p. 8/11; [9] D'Ans, J., J. Löffler: Z. Anorg. Allg. Chem. 191 (1930) No. 1, p. 1/35; [10] Löffler, J.: Glastech. Ber. 42 (1969) No. 3, p. 92/6; [11] Holmquist, S. B.: J. Am. Ceram. Soc. 44 (1961) No. 2, p. 82/6; [12] Wu. P, G. Eriksson, A. D. Pelton: J. Am. Ceram. Soc. 76 (1993) No. 8, p. 2059/64.

digitization.method: Liquidus traced along the stroke centre (shortest ink path between the junctions, centred across the stroke); invariant lines from the horizontal strokes.
digitization.check: Compound lines (wt% SiO2): 2Na2O·SiO2 line at 32.7 (stoichiometric 32.6); 3Na2O·2SiO2 line at 39.3 (stoichiometric 39.3); Na2O·SiO2 line at 49.3 (stoichiometric 49.2); Na2O·2SiO2 line at 66.1 (stoichiometric 66.0). Invariant lines read 963 / 1005 / 837 / 805.5 / 800.5 °C (labels 962 / 1005 / 837 / 808 / 799). Sodium-orthosilicate maximum 1083 °C at 32.8 wt% (label 1078). Sodium-pyrosilicate maximum 1120 °C at 39.3 wt% (label 1115). Sodium-metasilicate maximum 1092 °C at 49.4 wt% (label 1088). Sodium-disilicate maximum 876 °C at 66.1 wt% (label 874). Sodium-oxide liquidus meets the axis at 1134 °C (label 1133). Silica liquidus meets the axis at 1718 °C (label 1725). Digitized vs printed compositions (wt% SiO2): 16.3 / '16.3', 36.5 / '36.5', 45.1 / '45.1', 61.8 / '62', 73.3 / '73.4', 73.5 / '73.5'.
